name: Gamma
tagline: AI slide deck, document, and webpage generator built for fast interactive presentations.
definition: Gamma is an AI presentation and document creation platform that generates visually polished, interactive slide decks, web pages, and documents from simple text prompts, outlines, or uploaded briefs.
why_it_matters: Gamma reimagined presentation design by replacing rigid PowerPoint templates with a fluid, web-native card format that formats typography, visual layouts, and charts automatically.
workplace_use_cases: Generating complete pitch decks for startup fundraising from raw text outlines
Creating interactive onboarding documentation and company slide decks
Converting Word documents or meeting notes into visual presentation cards
Designing client proposal decks with embedded web links and video embeds
how_to_use: Sign in at gamma.app, choose 'Generate', paste an outline or enter a topic prompt, select a visual color theme, and let Gamma build the complete deck.
key_features: Generates interactive slide decks, web pages, and documents in seconds
Automated layout formatting with fluid card canvas
One-click theme restyling and image generation controls
Analytics tracking for view duration and slide engagement

pricing.free_tier_details: 400 free AI credits upon signup (~10 deck generations).

paid_plans.name: Plus
paid_plans.notes: 400 AI credits renewed monthly, badge removal, export to PDF/PPTX.

paid_plans.name: Pro
paid_plans.notes: Unlimited AI credits, advanced AI image models, custom fonts.

name: Tome
tagline: AI narrative tool for building dynamic visual presentations and sales collateral.
definition: Tome is an AI research and presentation platform that transforms text briefs, whitepapers, and product specs into visual presentation narratives. It pairs generative text outlines with custom AI images and dynamic web embeds.
why_it_matters: Tome pioneered prompt-to-presentation workflows, focusing on storytelling structure and generative visual accompaniment for executive presentations.
workplace_use_cases: Drafting executive strategy presentations from long PDF whitepapers
Creating visual product design specs with embedded Figma prototypes
Generating sales proposal decks tailored to specific client verticals
Building interactive educational courses and visual training modules
how_to_use: Visit tome.app, enter a prompt (e.g. 'Build a 10-slide strategy deck for expanding into enterprise SaaS'), select layout preferences, and edit generated slides.
key_features: Prompt-to-deck narrative structure generation
Native live web embeds (Figma, Framer, YouTube, Looker)
Automated slide layout re-formatting and typography controls
Mobile-responsive slide viewing layout

pricing.free_tier_details: Free tier with limited AI credits and public presentation links.

paid_plans.name: Professional
paid_plans.notes: Unlimited AI creation, custom branding, export to PDF, analytics.

paid_plans.name: Enterprise
paid_plans.notes: Custom templates, security reviews, dedicated account manager.

name: Beautiful.ai
tagline: Smart presentation software with design guardrails that automatically adjust slide layouts.
definition: Beautiful.ai is an intelligent presentation design workspace. Its 'Smart Slides' technology applies automatic typography, alignment, and color rules as you add content, ensuring every slide complies with professional design standards.
why_it_matters: Beautiful.ai solves the 'ugly slide' problem in corporate settings by preventing users from misaligning text boxes or breaking slide visual grid hierarchies.
workplace_use_cases: Standardizing corporate presentation templates across large sales teams
Generating clean financial charts and comparison slides in seconds
Collaborating on quarterly business review (QBR) slide decks
Maintaining total brand design compliance across corporate decks
how_to_use: Log in at beautiful.ai, select a Smart Slide layout, type your bullet points or upload data, and watch the slides format automatically.
key_features: Smart Slide engine for real-time automatic layout realignment
Designer AI for converting text prompts into branded slides
Enterprise brand library controls (fonts, logos, color palettes)
Seamless PowerPoint (PPTX) import and export

paid_plans.name: Pro
paid_plans.notes: Unlimited slides, AI text/image generation, export to PowerPoint.

paid_plans.name: Team
paid_plans.notes: Shared company slide library, corporate brand control, central billing.

name: Pitch AI
tagline: Collaborative presentation platform with integrated AI slide generation and deck editing.
definition: Pitch AI is a collaborative presentation workspace that generates slide decks from prompts or text documents while offering professional design team collaboration tools.
why_it_matters: Pitch combines generative AI slide building with real-time multi-user editing and presentation engagement analytics.
workplace_use_cases: Drafting startup pitch decks and client proposals in branded design systems
Collaborating live with team members on presentation slide decks
Tracking presentation view analytics and slide drop-off rates
how_to_use: Sign in at pitch.com, click 'Draft with AI', enter a prompt or brief, and customize the generated slides.
key_features: AI deck generator adhering to custom brand templates
Real-time team co-editing and presentation recordings
Slide view engagement analytics dashboard

pricing.free_tier_details: Free plan includes unlimited presentation creation and basic AI credits.

paid_plans.name: Pro
paid_plans.notes: Unlimited AI usage, custom fonts, video uploads, analytics.

name: Slidebean
tagline: AI pitch deck builder tailored for startup founders seeking investor funding.
definition: Slidebean is an AI presentation tool specifically designed for startup founders, combining automated slide design with investor pitch deck templates and financial modeling.
why_it_matters: Slidebean focuses on the startup fundraising ecosystem, pairing AI slide arrangement with proven investor deck structures.
workplace_use_cases: Building investor pitch decks matching successful Y Combinator startup formats
Formatting pitch deck typography and alignment automatically
Tracking investor engagement and time spent per slide
how_to_use: Go to slidebean.com, choose an investor deck template, type your content, and let AI format the layout.
key_features: Automated AI slide layout and alignment engine
Proven startup pitch deck template library
Investor viewer analytics tracking

paid_plans.name: All Access
paid_plans.notes: Unlimited deck creation, investor tracking analytics, financial models.

name: Canva Magic Design
tagline: AI design tool inside Canva for generating presentations, social media assets, and documents.
definition: Canva Magic Design is the generative AI suite embedded inside Canva, allowing users to create slide decks, social graphics, and visual documents from text prompts.
why_it_matters: Canva brought generative AI presentations to over 150 million users, offering seamless access to Canva's vast stock media library.
workplace_use_cases: Generating presentation decks from raw text outlines inside Canva
Creating branded social media graphic sets instantly
Converting presentation slides into visual documents
how_to_use: Open Canva, click Magic Design, type your presentation topic, choose a brand style, and generate.
key_features: Generates custom presentations with matching typography and stock images
Magic Write inline copy generator
Brand Hub integration for automated brand style matching

pricing.free_tier_details: Free access with daily Magic Design generation limits.

paid_plans.name: Canva Pro
paid_plans.notes: Unlimited Magic Design features, full brand hub, 100M+ stock assets.

name: Decktopus
tagline: AI presentation generator built for fast corporate deck creation with voiceover narration.
definition: Decktopus is an AI presentation deck builder that automatically structures slides, adds speaker notes, suggests interactive forms, and embeds voiceover narration.
why_it_matters: Decktopus focuses on fast corporate presentations with built-in audience lead generation forms inside slides.
workplace_use_cases: Creating interactive sales proposal decks with embedded lead capture forms
Generating training slide decks complete with automated speaker notes
Adding AI voiceover narration to online presentation links
how_to_use: Visit decktopus.com, enter your presentation topic and target audience, and select a theme.
key_features: Automated slide layout with speaker notes generation
Embedded lead capture forms and live polling inside slides
AI voiceover narration generator

pricing.free_tier_details: Free plan includes basic deck creation and credits.

paid_plans.name: Pro AI
paid_plans.notes: 750 AI credits/month, custom domain, PDF export.

paid_plans.name: Business AI
paid_plans.notes: 1,000 AI credits/month, team management, lead generation analytics.

name: Prezi AI
tagline: AI-powered zooming presentation tool that transforms structured text into dynamic mind-map decks.
definition: Prezi AI is the generative extension of Prezi's famous non-linear zooming presentation canvas, turning prompts into interactive, mind-map style presentations.
why_it_matters: Prezi AI brings non-linear spatial storytelling to AI presentation tools, creating engaging visual narrative maps.
workplace_use_cases: Creating spatial, interactive presentation decks for keynote speeches
Mapping complex business strategies into visual zooming presentation trees
Delivering engaging virtual presentations via Prezi Video
how_to_use: Sign in at prezi.com, prompt Prezi AI with your presentation topic, and customize the visual canvas.
key_features: Generates non-linear zooming presentation spatial structures
Prezi Video integration for presenting alongside video screens
AI text and layout styling tools

pricing.free_tier_details: Free tier includes up to 3 public presentations.

paid_plans.name: Plus
paid_plans.notes: Unlimited presentations, PDF export, offline desktop app.

paid_plans.name: Premium
paid_plans.notes: Advanced analytics, Prezi Video powerful features.

name: Simplified
tagline: All-in-one AI platform for graphic design, video editing, copywriting, and presentation generation.
definition: Simplified is an all-in-one content creation workspace offering AI presentation generation, graphic design tools, video editing, and copywriting.
why_it_matters: Simplified combines presentation design with social media post scheduling in a single workspace.
workplace_use_cases: Generating presentation decks from text briefs
Creating matching social media graphics for presentations
Scheduling multi-channel social media posts
how_to_use: Go to simplified.com, select AI Presentation, type your prompt, and customize.
key_features: AI presentation, graphic design, and video editor tools
Social media post scheduling dashboard
Multi-brand asset kits

pricing.free_tier_details: Free tier includes basic design tools and AI credits.

paid_plans.name: Pro
paid_plans.notes: 1 user, 100k AI words, advanced presentation tools.
